Task: Write a Helm chart deploying a multi-container Pod (sidecar pattern): main application container and a Fluent Bit log-shipping sidecar with a shared volume.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: sidecar-logging
description: Production Helm chart for multi-container Pod with Fluent Bit sidecar
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.16.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 2
image:
  main:
    repository: nginx
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    tag: "1.25-alpine"
  fluentbit:
    repository: fluent/fluent-bit
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    tag: "2.1.10"
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 1000
  fsGroup: 2000
resources:
  main:
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  fluentbit:
    limits:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 50m
      memory: 64Mi
volume:
  name: shared-logs
  mountPath: /var/log/app
fluentbitConfig:
  flush: 5
  output: "stdout"
---
# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "sidecar-logging.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "sidecar-logging.chart" . }}
{{ include "sidecar-logging.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "sidecar-logging.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "sidecar-logging.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end -}}
{{- define "sidecar-logging.name" -}}sidecar-logging{{- end -}}
{{- define "sidecar-logging.chart" -}}{{ printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" }}{{- end -}}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "sidecar-logging.name" . }}-fluentbit
  labels:
    {{- include "sidecar-logging.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
data:
  fluent-bit.conf: |
    [SERVICE]
        Flush         {{ .Values.fluentbitConfig.flush }}
        Daemon        off
        Log_Level     info
    [INPUT]
        Name          tail
        Path          {{ .Values.volume.mountPath }}/*.log
        Parser        docker
        Tag           app.*
    [OUTPUT]
        Name          {{ .Values.fluentbitConfig.output }}
        Match         *
---
# FILE: templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "sidecar-logging.name" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "sidecar-logging.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "sidecar-logging.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "sidecar-logging.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
    spec:
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: main
          image: "{{ .Values.image.main.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.main.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.main.pullPolicy }}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources.main | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: {{ .Values.volume.name }}
              mountPath: {{ .Values.volume.mountPath }}
        - name: fluentbit
          image: "{{ .Values.image.fluentbit.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.fluentbit.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.fluentbit.pullPolicy }}
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.resources.fluentbit | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: {{ .Values.volume.name }}
              mountPath: {{ .Values.volume.mountPath }}
            - name: fluentbit-config
              mountPath: /fluent-bit/etc/fluent-bit.conf
              subPath: fluent-bit.conf
      volumes:
        - name: {{ .Values.volume.name }}
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: fluentbit-config
          configMap:
            name: {{ include "sidecar-logging.name" . }}-fluentbit
            defaultMode: 0444
